title: PHP 5.6.15 is available
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 5.6.15. Several bugs have been fixed. All PHP 5.6 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 5.6.15 please visit our , Windows binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
